component: Actual native DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 attention and learned-router FFN block composition
implementation: src/transformer/trellis_block.h in existing transformer Trellis module
prerequisites: Prepared SAME canonical producer/HC request; staged host history; matching index_begin and hc_begin once per batch. Checkpoint block order, serialized callers, no interleaved lower-level mutation while a block is pending
execution: HC mix runs optional Engram and normalizes F32 carried collapse directly into existing F16 FFN input
Actual attention_forward_native produces F32 delta and commits its local KV/index/ring visibility
HC apply updates streams; FFN HC mix publishes next carry and normalizes directly to the same F16 input buffer
Actual run_learned selects checkpoint routing/expert arithmetic and computes routed plus shared FFN
Matching HC apply updates streams and publishes a borrowed final block stream view
retry: Engram BUSY retains attention-mix phase. Expert-placement BUSY retains the already normalized FFN site, its epoch, index generation, layer and admit policy. Retry SAME layer/policy; completed attention and its visibility update are not repeated
failure: Scalar/ticket/order/policy rejection queues nothing. Any actual branch rejection/failure drains/releases the WHOLE canonical request, including after local attention visibility commit. Host history and position remain pending; reset/replay required. No simulated GPU rollback
result_lifetime: Binds session/request generation, HC/history/index epoch, layer, token count, position and stream view. Expires on next accepted block attempt, history finalization, HC reuse, reset/free/failure. Current is not a GPU completion proof
ownership: Only bounded request-local control fields added to existing TrellisRequest; sizeof request is included in existing host quota query. No new module, GPU kernel, backend weight copy or resident activation buffer

reference.method: Unchanged original attention AST/kernels/projection methods, norm/RoPE/HC/routing/expert-decode/shared-FFN source kernels and actual checkpoint weights. Actual prior-block output drives the next block; no synthetic branch substitutions
reference.scope: Initial layers0/1 including Engram1, batch sizes1/7 at position0, real embedding and compressed tokenizer history. Partial model prefix only
reference.source_integrity: Existing pinned producers/sources/binaries and immutable core/router/parameter references checked; 792 expert component provenance records; original numeric corpus captured before candidate execution and replayed unchanged
reference.precision: Matched source cuBLAS13.10, explicit original INT4 BF16 lookup -> Exllama F16 Engram adapter; not original Diffbot full-forward numerical equivalence

qualification.coverage: 16 actual block executions, 24 forced BUSY retries, 178 checks, 20812288 exact bytes; two sessions, two repeats; actual normalized inputs, attention/FFN deltas, selected IDs/weights and residual streams
qualification.busy_proof: After expert BUSY: two HC input normalizations, one attention residual apply, attention ring cursor advanced once, host position still0. Wrong retry policy rejects. Successful retry adds only FFN residual; no repeated attention
qualification.faults: Attention QKV rejection and FFN router rejection after actual attention/local visibility commit release the whole request; pending history unchanged. Peer ticket AND peer stream remain exact. Profile resets/rebuilds failed owner and matches complete real prefix again
qualification.sanitizers: ASan/UBSan all new C code/probe; GPU memcheck full leak check and initcheck zero errors, zero bytes/allocations leaked. No new GPU kernels or unbounded whole-core racecheck
qualification.regression: Existing 800-site HC/Engram source chain passes with rebuilt code; strict Qwen192/192 sampled IDs, first8/8 words, count0/8 mismatches, word prefix147/147
qualification.measurement_boundary: Numerical probes install diagnostic callbacks that read intermediate boundaries and add completion fences. Separate profile restores real callbacks and compares final real-prefix output after capture

placement.policy: admit=0 temporary policy; no new RAM/decode admission. Existing immutable checkpoint source bound and leases enforce placement quotas
placement.excludes: Immutable core/parameter/router weights, base request/attention/HC/Engram/rings/history, allocator/library/driver/context and OS page-cache overhead. Not total RSS/VRAM

profile.scope: Real first-two-block prefix R7, temporary placement (admit=0), prepared fresh session request, real callbacks, no diagnostic spies. Source OS page cache is uncontrolled; not a full model or vLLM comparison.
